title: Demo: persistent cough (synthetic)
candidateBrief: You are a doctor in a GP surgery. Mr Alan Price, 58, has come in about a cough. Take a focused history. You have 8 minutes.

patient.name: Alan Price
patient.persona: A retired bus driver, polite but a bit gruff, downplays his symptoms and dislikes fuss.
patient.openingLine: Morning, doctor. It's this cough, really.

rubric.label: Introduces self and gains consent
rubric.exampleQuestion: Hello, I'm one of the doctors. Is it okay if I ask you some questions today?

rubric.label: Asks about coughing up blood
rubric.exampleQuestion: Have you coughed up any blood?

rubric.label: Takes a smoking history
rubric.exampleQuestion: Do you smoke, or have you ever smoked?

rubric.label: Explores the patient's concerns
rubric.exampleQuestion: Is there anything in particular you're worried this might be?

rubric.label: Summarises and invites questions
rubric.exampleQuestion: Can I summarise what you've told me? Do you have any questions?

facts.text: I've had a cough that just won't go away.

source.quote: Synthetic demo content for engine tests. Not clinical content.

facts.text: Last week I noticed a streak of blood when I coughed.
